about:
SON Metal Fab operates from Ashland, Virginia, just north of Richmond. The business traces its roots to Butch Harrison, who founded the company as Specialty's Our Name with the strong support of his family; it later adopted the SON Metal Fab name. A founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom sheet metal fabrication, welding, machining, and manufacturing services. Its capabilities include laser cutting, CNC punching, CNC bending, rolling, deburring, and powder coating, along with precision parts production. Equipment on the floor features a ¼″–10′ AccurShear with CNC controls, a Hurco CNC lathe with bar feeder, and a Hurco machining center. The company does not publish facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

SON Metal Fab serves a broad range of clients in the Richmond, Virginia area. The website does not list specific industry sectors or named customers, focusing instead on local and regional project work of varying duration.

The company emphasizes its 30 years of industry experience and a dedication to craftsmanship and attention to detail. Experienced project managers are available to assist with drafting and prototyping, supporting customers from concept through production.
